text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The deserted island project is progressing smoothly.
Today, I decided to help out with further development.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to train hard~!
The Classic campaign is just around the corner, after all!
choice_data_list: I'll be supporting you too, so let's do our best!
I'll support you too, so let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
...Huh? Isn't that over there—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Facilities... The most important one,
after all... is the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There was Oguri Cap, an Umamusume from the same generation as Sakura Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes! Oguri-san is all
our peers have been talking about.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
She's won race after race back home.
If we were to compete, she would definitely be a formidable rival.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, I can't lose either!
Sakura Chiyono O, firing on all cylinders!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Heave... ho.
Urgh, so heavy...!
choice_data_list: There's stone material inside, so be careful, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! ...T-This is nothing...!
'If a rolling stone gathers no moss, we sink or swim together'...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"No way!?
O-Oguri-san, are you really carrying that...!?"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. What a kitchen needs is a large furnace...
We'll probably need about this much in materials.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~!?
T-There are so many of them...?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Alright.
...Now I can eat until I'm full.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible...
You carried them all over in the blink of an eye!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Someone like me...
struggled just to carry a single one...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...No, not yet!
Let's keep going, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *phew*...
Th-There are still this many wooden crates left...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I want to carry more, but...
My arms are starting to get a little tired...
choice_data_list: Then how about trying to hold it differently?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I see...! All right, let's try out different things.
If you have any advice, keep it coming!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho!
...Hehe, this might be easier than before!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Still, to think that just straightening my back
would make it this much easier. What a great discovery!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! I'll write it down in my Chiyo Notebook!
That way, carrying it should be much easier next time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Sakura Chiyono O steadily
carried the materials over—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: We are... finiiished!
choice_data_list: Good work today! You gave it everything you had!
Good work today! You gave it your all!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Chiyono O.
...For the cafeteria's sake.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: T-That wasn't my intention, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wait, all that lumber over there...
Don't tell me you brought it, Oguri-san?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... We'll need not just the stove,
but plenty of tableware as well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
She's truly amazing...
...I have to catch up to her, too—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I've made up my mind! I will... work much, much harder!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "Please watch me! I'll grow by leaps and bounds and become an amazing Umamusume... so I won't lose to Oguri-san!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I don't quite get it, but...
that suits me just fine.
